subject: Post-call: Buyflow roles, security gating & internal enablement plan
messages:
From: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: 2026-11-20T15:02:00Z
Subject: Post-call recap: Hyperledger discovery (roles + gating + next asks)

Teams — quick recap from earlier today with Lara and Tom at Hyperledger AI. High level: they liked the latency/cost profile we showed for their summary-generation flow but have three clear gating areas before procurement will engage: (1) security review + encryption/KMS, (2) procurement terms & SOC2 evidence, (3) economic owner sign-off (budget runway tied to Q1 product roadmap).

What we captured on roles (please confirm):
- Economic / Budget owner: Tom Reed (VP Finance) — interested in TCO and unit economics across 3 months.
- Security reviewer: Maya Lopez (Head of InfoSec) — will need architecture diagram, data flow, KMS details, and a SOC2 artifact.
- Technical champion: Lara Benson (Sr. ML Eng) — product lead who will drive the PoC and measure quality metrics (latency and hallucination/error rate).

Immediate asks I committed to:
1) Put together a short Mutual Action Plan (MAP) with owners, timeline, and deliverables — attached draft (Hyperledger_MutualActionPlan_v1.xlsx).
2) Share a one-page champion pack (talk tracks + ROI bullets) Lara can use internally — attaching a first pass.
3) Circulate the specific security checklist items and sample architecture doc for Maya.

Next steps for us: can each of you take the following and reply with notes by EOD Friday 11/22?
- Neha: draft concise security artifact list (SOC2 excerpt, KMS flow, encryption at rest/envelope details).
- Priyom: produce ROI bullets / unit economics that speak to Tom (3- and 12-month view) and annotate which numbers we can commit to now vs those requiring PoC data.

I'll take the champion pack and tailor it to Lara's talking points, then loop in legal for a light T&Cs pre-read.

Attachments: Hyperledger_MutualActionPlan_v1.xlsx, Champion_Talk_Tracks_v2.pdf

Thanks — David
David Kim
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-22T09:18:00Z
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: Hyperledger discovery (roles + gating + next asks)

David / Priyom — thanks for the clear recap. Notes inline and a suggested security intake checklist below. I flagged items Maya will push on.

Quick confirmations:
- Tom = economic owner (budget constraints into Feb). He asked for a 3-month cost delta vs status quo (current self-hosted vector search + cheap CPUs).
- Maya will require: architecture diagram, data retention policy, network segmentation details, KMS provider & rotation policy, SOC2 type II report (most recent), and a short threat model for inference data.

Suggested security intake checklist (to send to Maya as a single doc):
- Latest SOC2 Type II report (redwood-ps-soc2-2026.pdf)
- Architecture diagram (public cloud VPC + private subnets, egress restrictions)
- KMS integration details (customer-managed keys option + example KMS ARNs)
- Data retention & purge policy for KV cache + logs
- Access controls & audit logging: who has key rotation privileges + sample audit log output
- Pen test / vulnerability disclosure policy

Operational asks for MAP: owners + fallback options (if we fail to meet SOC2 timeline, we propose a short-term dedicated environment with restricted access).

Priyom — for the ROI bullets, recommend two versions: (A) conservative baseline (no quality lift assumed) and (B) upside (with 15% productivity/quality improvement). I can coordinate to get Maya's expected PoC metrics so we can calibrate PoC acceptance criteria.

I'll draft the intake doc and share by EOD — putting the SOC2 reference and the architecture sketch into a single PDF.

Neha Kapoor
Director, Trust & Security | Redwood Inference

Highlights for your internal runbook:
- One-slide ROI: 3-month delta and 12-month projection with conservative and upside lanes (ROI-one-pager.xlsx attached).
- Security bucket: Neha will send a single intake PDF with SOC2 excerpt + architecture sketch for Maya’s review.

If you want I can tailor the champion bullets further to include specific error-rate thresholds they might care about.

Thanks — looking forward to next steps.

-David
